cards.front: Por favor, explícale a la peluquera si quieres llevar el pelo suelto o recogido.
cards.back: Please let the hairdresser know if you want to wear your hair up or down.

cards.front: Por favor, dile también si tienes pensado llevar un tocado.
cards.back: Please let her know as well if you are planning to wear a head piece.

cards.front: Si es así, por favor dile si lo vas a comprar tú o si querrías que lo comprara ella por ti.
cards.back: If so, please let her know if you are buying it yourself or if you would like her to buy it for you.

cards.front: Por favor, dile a Steve con qué canción querrías empezar el baile.
cards.back: Please let Steve know which song you would like to pick for your first dance.

cards.front: Por favor, dile a la florista qué flores querrías incluir en el ramo de flores.
cards.back: Please let the florist know which flowers you would like to include in your bouquet.

cards.front: Por favor, dile al fotógrafo cuáles son los invitados a los que quieres que saque fotos.
cards.back: Please let the photographer know which guests you really want photos of.

cards.front: Te agradeceríamos que nos dijeras el viernes, como muy tarde, quién va a ser la madrina.
cards.back: We'd be grateful if you could let us know who is going to be your Maid of Honor by Friday.

cards.front: Te agradeceríamos que nos dijeras también quién va a ser el padrino.
cards.back: We'd be grateful if you could let us know who is going to be the best man too.

cards.front: Te agradeceríamos que nos dijeras quién te gustaría que se encargara de recibir y sentar a los invitados en la iglesia esta noche, a las nueve como muy tarde.
cards.back: We'd be grateful if you could let us know who you would like to be the usher by nine o'clock tonight.

cards.front: Dile a mi asistente que querrías que se enviaran las invitaciones el lunes como muy tarde.
cards.back: Let my assistant know that you would like the invitations to be sent on Monday at the latest.

cards.front: Dile que quieres probar el menú y la tarta el martes como muy tarde.
cards.back: Let him know that you want to do the menu and cake tasting on Tuesday at the latest.

cards.front: Diles que quieres hacer la prueba de maquillaje y peinado el miércoles como muy tarde.
cards.back: Let them know that you want to do the trial make-up and hair demonstrations on Wednesday at the latest.

cards.front: Avísame si hay más gente involucrada en la ceremonia.
cards.back: Let me know of any other people involved in the ceremony.

cards.front: Avisa al cura si hay alguna lectura en la que estéis especialmente interesados.
cards.back: Let the priest know of any readings you are especially interested in.

cards.front: Avísame si hay algo más que necesites.
cards.back: Let me know of anything else you need.

cards.front: La sirvienta dejó entrar al vendedor a la casa.
cards.back: The maid let the salesman into the house.

cards.front: Ella no dejó entrar al electricista porque no le conocía.
cards.back: She didn't let the electrician in because she didn't know him.

cards.front: El fontanero está en la puerta. ¿Le dejas entrar, por favor?
cards.back: The plumber is at the door. Can you let him in, please?

cards.front: Fernando Alonso paró en el semáforo para que yo saliera del coche.
cards.back: Fernando Alonso stopped at the traffic lights to let me out.

cards.front: Le pedí al chófer que me dejara salir al llegar al cruce.
cards.back: I asked the chauffeur to let me out at the crossroads.

cards.front: Sue le dijo al taxista que le dejara en la esquina de Blue Street con Green Street.
cards.back: Sue told the taxi driver to let her out at the corner of Blue Street with Green Street.

cards.front: Matt decepcionó a Lisa al presentarse en el teatro cuando la obra iba por la mitad.
cards.back: Matt let Lisa down by turning up at the theatre when the play was half way through.

cards.front: La semana anterior él la decepcionó muchísimo al no acordarse de su aniversario.
cards.back: The week before he let her down badly by not remembering their anniversary.

cards.front: Y antes de eso la decepcionó al no querer ayudarla cuando ella se lo pidió.
cards.back: And before that he let her down by not helping her when she asked him to.

cards.front: El gorila de la discoteca nos dejó pasar a pesar de que estaba abarrotada de gente.
cards.back: The bouncer let us through despite the nightclub being packed with people.

cards.front: Si no nos dejan pasar, siempre podemos colarnos.
cards.back: If they don't let us through, we can always sneak in.

cards.front: ¡Por favor, dejad pasar a la ambulancia!
cards.back: Please let the ambulance through the crowd!

cards.front: Los niños se fueron al parque en cuanto dejó de llover tanto.
cards.back: The children went to the park as soon as the rain let up.

cards.front: Sacaré a mi perro a pasear una vez deje de llover tanto.
cards.back: I'll take my dog for a walk once the rain lets up.

cards.front: No iré a casa de Peter en coche a no ser que deje de nevar.
cards.back: I won't drive to Peter's unless the snow lets up.

cards.front: Cuando era niño, mis padres me dejaban dormir en la casita del árbol del jardín en verano.
cards.back: When I was growing up, my parents would let me sleep in the tree house in the garden in summer.

cards.front: Cuando era pequeña, mi madre me dejaba ayudarla cuando estaba en la cocina haciendo pasteles.
cards.back: When I was growing up, my mother would let me help her when she was in the kitchen baking cakes.

cards.front: Cuando éramos niños, nuestros padres nos dejaban tomar un vasito de vino con la comida los domingos.
cards.back: When we were growing up, our parents would allow us to have a small glass of wine with our lunch on Sundays.

cards.front: Con 21 años su madre todavía no le dejaba salir a ella sola con chicos.
cards.back: When she was 21, her mother still wouldn't let her go out with boys alone.

cards.front: Incluso con 18 años mis padres no me dejaban beber alcohol en casa.
cards.back: Even when I was 18, my parents wouldn't let me drink alcohol at home.

cards.front: Con 16 años su madre no le dejaba ir a discotecas con sus amigas.
cards.back: When she was 16, her mother wouldn't allow her to go to discos with her friends.

cards.front: Cuando eras joven, ¿tus padres te dejaban decir tacos delante de ellos?
cards.back: When you were young, would your parents let you say swearwords in front of them?

cards.front: ¿Tu madre te dejaba llevar maquillaje cuando eras adolescente?
cards.back: Would your mum let you wear makeup when you were a teenager?

cards.front: ¿Sus padres siempre le dejaban hablar así a las personas mayores cuando era niño?
cards.back: Would his parents always allow him to speak like that to adults when he was a kid?

cards.front: ¡Tenías que dejar entrar a la fiesta a tus colegas borrachos del rugby! ¿De verdad pensabas que se iban a comportar bien?
cards.back: You would let your drunken rugby friends into the party! Did you really think they were going to behave themselves?

cards.front: Estaba claro que ella iba a dejar que viniera su ex novio, ¿no crees?
cards.back: She would let her ex-boyfriend come, wouldn't she?

cards.front: Era de esperar que ellos dejaran a sus niños tatuarse.
cards.back: They would allow their kids to have tattoos, wouldn't they?

cards.front: Mi padre tenía un Rolls Royce, pero nunca me dejaba conducirlo.
cards.back: My father used to have a Rolls Royce, but he would never let me drive it.

cards.front: Antes yo era su novio, pero como nunca me dejaba salir con mis amigos, decidí terminar mi relación con ella.
cards.back: I used to be her boyfriend, but as she would never let me go out with my friends I decided to end my relationship with her!

cards.front: Antes había muchos bares en esta calle, pero no nos dejaban entrar en ninguno.
cards.back: There used to be lots of bars in this street, but none of them would allow us to go in.

cards.front: Por mucho que le ruegue a ella, no me dejará ir con ella.
cards.back: No matter how much I beg, she won't let me go with her.

cards.front: Por muy convincente que sea ella, él no la dejará conducir su coche.
cards.back: No matter how convincing she is, he won't let her drive his car.

cards.front: Por mucho que llore él, ella no le dejará volver a casa.
cards.back: No matter how much he cries, she won't let him come home.

cards.front: Haga lo que haga, no me dejarán ir con ellos.
cards.back: No matter what I do, they will not let me go with them.

cards.front: Diga lo que diga, no me dejarán hacer el discurso.
cards.back: No matter what I say, they won't let me make the speech.

cards.front: Pase lo que pase, no te dejaré caer.
cards.back: No matter what happens, I won't let you fall.

cards.front: No hay forma de que él te deje ocupar su puesto cuando se vaya. Se asegurará de ello.
cards.back: There's no way he'll let you take over his job when he leaves. He'll make sure of that.

cards.front: No hay forma de permitir que ella entre en mi habitación. ¡Huele mal!
cards.back: There's no way I'll allow her to come into my room. She smells bad!

cards.front: No hay forma de que él me deje conducir su coche. Es muy testarudo.
cards.back: There's no way he'll let me drive his car. He's too stubborn.

cards.front: Simplemente, no me dejarán participar.
cards.back: They just won't allow me to join in.

cards.front: Ella se queja porque, simplemente, no le dejan ayudar en la cocina.
cards.back: She complains because they just don't allow her to help out in the kitchen.

cards.front: Simplemente, no le dejarán hacer su trabajo.
cards.back: They just won't allow him to do his job.

cards.front: No están dispuestos a dejarle unirse al equipo de fútbol.
cards.back: They're not willing to let him join the football team.

cards.front: Sam no está dispuesto a dejar que su perro coma chocolate.
cards.back: Sam isn't willing to let his dog eat chocolate.

cards.front: Josh no está dispuesto a dejar que sus niños vayan solos al parque.
cards.back: Josh isn't willing to let his children go to the park alone.

cards.front: Voy a alquilar mi oficina a alguien porque ese dinero extra me resultará útil.
cards.back: I'm going to let my office to someone because the extra money will come in handy.

cards.front: ¿Alquilaste tu piso a esa pareja cuando pasaste aquel año en el extranjero?
cards.back: Did you let your flat to that couple when you spent that year abroad?

cards.front: No es muy rentable alquilar pisos a nadie en este momento.
cards.back: It isn't very profitable to let flats to anyone at the moment.

cards.front: Tengo mi casa a la venta desde hace mucho tiempo.
cards.back: My house has been for sale for a long time.

cards.front: Me temo que mi coche no está en venta.
cards.back: I'm afraid my car isn't for sale.

cards.front: ¡Esa furgoneta es perfecta para mi negocio! ¡Y está en venta!
cards.back: That van is perfect for my business. And it's for sale!

cards.front: La ropa de mi talla nunca está de rebajas.
cards.back: Clothes in my size are never on sale.

cards.front: Hay muchos ordenadores muy buenos de rebajas en este momento.
cards.back: There are lots of very good computers on sale at the moment.

cards.front: ¿Has visto aquella falda fantástica que está de rebajas?
cards.back: Did you see that fabulous skirt that's on sale?

cards.front: Hay una habitación vacía en la casa que estoy alquilando. La quiero subarrendar.
cards.back: There's an empty room in the house that I'm renting. I want to sublet it.

cards.front: ¿Se enfadará tu casero si se entera de que estás subarrendando?
cards.back: Will your landlord get angry if he finds out that you're subletting?

cards.front: No quiero que subarriendes el cuarto de los invitados. Lo necesitamos para los invitados.
cards.back: I don't want you to sublet the spare room. We need it for visitors.

cards.front: Alquilemos una furgoneta para hacer la mudanza más fácil.
cards.back: Let's hire a van to help us move house.

cards.front: Alquilé un coche y fui conduciendo a Andalucía.
cards.back: I hired a car and drove to Andalucia.

cards.front: He alquilado un coche casi todos los fines de semana de este año. Creo que ya me debería comprar uno.
cards.back: I've hired a car almost every weekend this year. I think I should buy one now.

cards.front: No se permiten los juegos de pelota en el césped.
cards.back: Ball games are not allowed on the grass.

cards.front: No se admiten perros en la tienda.
cards.back: Dogs are not allowed in the shop.

cards.front: No se permite el uso de móviles en clase en ningún momento.
cards.back: Mobile phones are not allowed in class at any time.

cards.front: No está permitido fumar en este edificio.
cards.back: Smoking is not allowed anywhere in this building.

cards.front: No está permitido correr en los pasillos del colegio.
cards.back: Running is not allowed in the school corridors.

cards.front: Las caricias no se permiten en la piscina.
cards.back: Petting is not allowed in the swimming pool.

cards.front: A este preso no le permiten recibir visitas.
cards.back: This prisoner is not allowed to have visitors.

cards.front: No me permiten salir esta noche.
cards.back: I'm not allowed to go out tonight.

cards.front: No se les permite decir nada a la prensa hasta que termine el juicio.
cards.back: They're not allowed to say anything to the press until the trial has finished.

cards.front: Mi madre dice que puedo quedarme fuera hasta la una.
cards.back: My mum says that I'm allowed to stay out until 1 am tonight.

cards.front: Nos permiten un descanso por la mañana y otro por la tarde.
cards.back: We're allowed to have a break in the morning and one in the afternoon.

cards.front: Le dejaron a él irse a casa el día después de la operación.
cards.back: He was allowed to go home the day after the operation.

cards.front: ¿Te permitirán venir a nuestra fiesta?
cards.back: Will you be allowed to come to our party?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no se les permite donar fondos a nuestra campaña para las elecciones?
cards.back: Why aren't they allowed to donate any funds to the election campaign?

cards.front: ¿No te permitieron apelar la decisión?
cards.back: Weren't you allowed to appeal the decision?
